limits: The three resource inconsistencies are confirmed source/test findings, not individually proven causes of the 1607 renewed deaths.
Hourly exposure samples current custody/location for a full hour, including newly acquired material and the first post-migration boundary; detailed exposure history is absent.
Fixed 30 kg capacity, three-person parties, fractional retry shipments and 1e-8 kg delivery tolerance remain controller conventions.
Connected standing stocks are not exclusive catchments or annual sustainable production.
Infant feeding, local gestation/birth, age-dependent growth, handling labor and a complete daily food-flow account remain open.
Local inhabited handover exceeds the live 1 GB allowance in combined sampled RSS and does not prove populated-host capacity.
The finite disk quota trials leave little room. Repacking retains exact archive bytes but does not shrink SQLite or solve unbounded region writes.
No seasonal or generational viability claim; four live-world communities remain extinct. No new renewal, reset, rewind, reseed or history deletion.

sourceReview.finding: Camp stocks, personal provisions/cargo and caravan provisions/offer/receive use one exponential elapsed-hour law at represented local tiles. Lost material returns once; internal intake/body and worn-fiber wear remain separate. Hour sampling and legacy escrow losses are explicit.

Journey formation, carrier loss, return exchange and raids use living carriers with personal external loads. Founding screens use shared cardinal land connectivity without generating territory. These are coarse transport and standing-stock screens, not ownership or renewable yield.

Both each original block and the whole original stream verify before same-codec denser replacements commit; replacements verify again. Identity/date/raw bytes remain authoritative. Each archive is a separate transaction before terrain loading; a held writer lease renews before long commit and a lost token aborts.

Roadmap active predecessor corrected from stale format 11 to actual format 12 before publication; architecture current meals now states shared demand rather than obsolete sequential food contention. Oxygen contention remains sequential. Migration 013 changes only labels at the boundary; future hourly loss and prototype logistics limits are documented.

New custody/access defects are not assigned a historical death count. Research separates production, custody, ingestion, oxidation, retention and loss, and records the missing daily flow ledger, remote birth/home supplies, infant feeding, growth and nonexclusive catchments.

limits: No claim of full physical realism, seasonal equilibrium or viable 300-founder generations.
Finite quota rehearsal does not prove future disk headroom, and inhabited local combined RSS is greater than the live memory allowance.
Structural scan does not inspect arbitrary runtime paths, all legacy-language behavior or every semantic dependency.
